criteria.summary: Collects far more than needed for shopping: precise location, contacts, and browsing activity across other sites.
criteria.clause: We collect information you provide and information gathered automatically, including your precise geolocation, device contacts where permitted, browsing history across our partner network, and inferences drawn about your interests and characteristics.

criteria.summary: Claims 'legitimate interests' for marketing and profiling - a broad basis that removes your consent from the equation.
criteria.clause: We process personal data on the basis of our legitimate interests, including direct marketing, product development, and the creation of audience profiles.

criteria.summary: Your data is sold. 'Trusted partners' means advertisers and data brokers, and the list can change without telling you.
criteria.clause: We may share or sell personal information to trusted partners, including advertising networks, analytics providers and data enrichment services, as updated from time to time.

criteria.summary: The policy does not say how long your data is kept. Under UK GDPR Article 13 it should. Treat this silence as a warning.
Tracks you across other websites using cookies and 'similar technologies', including for ad targeting.
criteria.clause: We and our partners use cookies, pixels and similar technologies to recognise your device across websites and over time, including to serve interest-based advertising.

criteria.summary: Does list your UK GDPR rights and gives a working contact route for exercising them.
criteria.clause: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object to the processing of your personal data, and to data portability. To exercise these rights contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example-shop.co.uk.

criteria.summary: Collects only your email address and account preferences - genuinely minimal.
criteria.clause: The only personal data we collect is the email address you register with and the preference settings you choose.

criteria.summary: Uses data solely to run the service you signed up for, on the basis of your contract with them.
criteria.clause: We process your email address solely to operate your account and deliver the service, on the lawful basis of performance of a contract.

criteria.summary: No selling, no advertisers. Only a hosting provider under a data processing agreement sees your data.
criteria.clause: We never sell personal data. Data is shared only with our hosting provider, acting as a processor under a written data processing agreement.

criteria.summary: Deletes your data 30 days after you close your account.
criteria.clause: If you close your account, all associated personal data is permanently deleted within 30 days.

criteria.summary: No cross-site tracking. Only strictly necessary cookies for login.
criteria.clause: We use only strictly necessary cookies required to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies, and we do not track you on other websites.

criteria.summary: Full UK GDPR rights listed with a one-click export and deletion tool.
criteria.clause: You can export or permanently delete your data at any time from Settings, and you retain all rights under UK data protection law including access, rectification and erasure.
